Addendum (2026-11-10): two grading defects found after the decision. Both re-runs leave it unchanged.

1. Router (found 11/08). On Colab, 18 of the 34 validation repositories (89 of 158 tasks) were graded without their dependency router: Debian's sitecustomize.py shadowed it, and many tests failed with ModuleNotFoundError for both arms. Fix: the router is loaded through a .pth line, and gold controls now run inside the scoring runtime (157/158). The addendum PREREGISTRATION_H_FIX.md (SHA-256 8ba29f486322684c41b607dcd438e7bf3fa12d16bf6661185f8ccc9e5273b9d4) was written before the 89 tasks were re-run with the same bundles and seeds.

2. Preinstalled packages (found 11/10). In the other 16 repositories, a src-layout package that is also installed in the Colab image was tested instead of the workspace, so the outcome did not depend on the patch: 12 attempts with an empty patch had been recorded as resolved. The addendum PREREGISTRATION_H_FIX2.md (SHA-256 dcc5b6a020cb054d4418702b2068af6159a849d4c5f8dad0c6e8d17ba2443630) was written before those 69 tasks were re-run. An empty-patch control now runs beside the gold control (0/158 in four runtimes).

Results from the frozen scripts, 466 pairs each (v6 vs H):
- as first graded: cap_no_edit 72 vs 72 (0%); paired solves -3 (12 vs 15, p = 0.70)
- after re-run 1: cap_no_edit 72 vs 73 (+1.4%); paired solves +5 (26 vs 21, p = 0.56)
- after re-run 2, every validation row from the fixed runtime: cap_no_edit 70 vs 71 (+1.4%); paired solves +4 (33 vs 29, p = 0.70); mean wall seconds 291.0 vs 285.5 (-1.9%)

The decision under the frozen rule is the same each time: H is dropped, v6 stays our baseline.

Deviation: the second addendum named a Colab A100 80 GB. None was available that day, so the 69 tasks ran on RTX PRO 6000 96 GB VMs (the GPU of the original plan). Both arms of a seed ran on the same VM, so the pairing is unaffected; mean wall time of the validation half is not comparable across gradings.

Both addenda, the per-attempt rows of all three gradings and the control summaries are in the eval-kit dataset, which becomes public at the deadline.

comments.rawMarkdown: Addendum (hardware). The validation rerun ran on a Colab A100 80 GB; the plan and the practice half used an RTX PRO 6000 96 GB, which Colab did not offer that day. Both arms of each seed ran on the same VM against one vLLM 0.19.1 server with identical sampling settings, so every one of the 466 pairs remains a same-machine comparison; only absolute wall times should not be compared across the two halves. Measured: each 158-task validation stage took 124-129 min at concurrency 8 (v6 123.8 / 128.2 min, H 128.8 / 127.5 min for seeds 101 / 102). All three deviations from the plan (snapshot rerun, runner hash, GPU) are listed together in PREREGISTRATION_H_RESULT.md, and the eval-kit dataset now holds v2 with the plan, the frozen scripts, both candidate bundles and the per-attempt outputs, so the chain from posted hash to decision can be re-run once the dataset becomes public at the deadline.

comments.rawMarkdown:
Result (2026-11-07, all 466 pairs): H fails the pre-registered primary outcome.

- cap_no_edit: v6 72/466 (15.5%) vs H 72/466 (15.5%), relative change 0% (pass required at least -30%). The two halves went opposite ways: practice 24 vs 35, validation 48 vs 37 (v6 vs H).
- Guard 1, paired solves H - v6: 127 vs 124 solved, 12 vs 15 discordant pairs, -3 (threshold >= -5), two-sided sign test p = 0.70. Holds.
- Guard 2, mean wall seconds per attempt: 307.5 vs 308.0 (+0.2%, threshold <= +5%). Holds.
- Decision under the frozen rule: H is dropped; v6 remains our baseline.

Deviations (full notes PREREGISTRATION_H_DEVIATION.md and PREREGISTRATION_H_RESULT.md will be published with the writeup):
1. The first validation pass (158 tasks x 2 seeds) was invalid for both arms: our rebuilt snapshots lacked .git, which the official harness needs for its diff baseline (500 "not a git repository" tool errors in one arm-seed; solve rates 7/316 and 9/316). The practice half was unaffected. We rebuilt the snapshots and reran only the validation half under the unchanged rule; the 466-pair decision uses the original practice half plus the rerun.
2. The Colab runner (inputs_val/run.py) therefore differs from the pre-registered hash (030c1ca8... -> 6520d24e...): a switch that skips the practice half, snapshots fetched with .git, a stricter smoke gate, and a checkpoint-resume fix that re-attempts tasks whose only result was a server connection error.

Per-task outcomes, traces and the audit JSON will be in the eval-kit dataset update.

firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Pre-registration for a confirmatory experiment in our Paper Track submission ("When the Leaderboard Cannot Tell"): a baseline prompt (v6) vs the same prompt with four hygiene lines changed, paired on 75 competition practice tasks plus 158 validation tasks from 34 non-competition repositories, two seeds (466 pairs). The plan fixes the primary mechanism outcome, two guards and the decision rule before any outcome of the new arm was read.

SHA-256 of the plan (PREREGISTRATION_H.md): b421a3d8843c53837ded438b9a30a9bd64ed320bc9d503ed6b906975e26fe19f

Analysis scripts frozen with it: analyze_val.py cb0c5b13981a259a1036e088995f903664fb7f179f2148d2f1bb2a519dd7b0b2 ; trace_audit.py fd4fb87c99b5d23664fcc88cb5a0a651467a6ebe752b32f1cf16d8f463296283

Disclosure: the runs were already in progress when the plan was written (14:10 UTC, Nov 6); the plan records exactly how far each run had progressed and that only attempt counts, not outcomes, had been read. The plan, scripts and all per-task results will be published with the writeup.
